gloss: sauce yakisoba; stir-fried noodles with Worcester sauce

definitions.gloss: sauce yakisoba; stir-fried noodles seasoned with Worcester-style sauce
definitions.explanation: The most common type of yakisoba in Japan, where stir-fried noodles are flavored with a thick, sweet-savory Worcester-style sauce and topped with ingredients like cabbage, pork, and pickled ginger.

examples.japanese: {昼|ひる}ごはん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ソース{焼|や}きそば⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made sauce yakisoba for lunch.

examples.japanese: ⟦{屋台|やたい}→屋台：10549_yatai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ソース{焼|や}きそば⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{定番|ていばん}→定番：12265_teiban⟧だ。
examples.english: Sauce yakisoba from food stalls is a festival staple.

examples.japanese: {富士宮|ふじのみや}やきそばや{横手|よこて}やきそば⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧、⟦{各地|かくち}→各地：00155_kakuchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ソース{焼|や}きそば⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名物|めいぶつ}→名物：05591_meibutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are famous sauce yakisoba specialties in various regions, such as Fujinomiya yakisoba and Yokote yakisoba.

notes:
The default style of ⟦{焼|や}きそば→焼きそば：13405_yakisoba⟧ in Japan. When Japanese people say ⟦{焼|や}きそば→焼きそば：13405_yakisoba⟧ without qualification, they almost always mean ソース{焼|や}きそば. The sauce used is a Japanese-style Worcester sauce ({中濃|ちゅうのう}⟦ソース→ソース：17673_soosu⟧ or ⟦{焼|や}きそば→焼きそば：13405_yakisoba⟧⟦{専用|せんよう}→専用：12385_senyou⟧⟦ソース→ソース：17673_soosu⟧), giving the noodles a distinctive dark color and sweet-savory flavor.

COMMON TOPPINGS:
- ⟦{紅生姜|べにしょうが}→紅生姜：28782_benishouga⟧: pickled red ginger
- {青海苔|あおのり}: green seaweed flakes
- ⟦{鰹節|かつおぶし}→鰹節：04935_katsuobushi⟧: bonito flakes
- ⟦{目玉焼|めだまや}き→目玉焼き：14946_medamayaki⟧: fried egg

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ソース{焼|や}きそば⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make sauce yakisoba
- ⟦{屋台|やたい}→屋台：10549_yatai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ソース{焼|や}きそば: food stall yakisoba
- ソース{焼|や}きそば⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧: yakisoba bread roll

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧⟦{焼|や}きそば→焼きそば：13405_yakisoba⟧: salt yakisoba — seasoned with salt instead of sauce; lighter flavor
